title: HB1268 (2020 Regular): Public Safety – Pilot Program – Handgun Permit – Church Property

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Maryland) (gun-policy Stage 5, Maryland); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Maryland text (First Reader; official copy, https://mgaleg.maryland.gov/2020RS/bills/hb/hb1268f.pdf)
provenance.note: first_reader: bill as filed; no vote recorded. Act ends June 30, 2022.

operative_text:
Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5-303(a)): EXCEPT AS PROVIDED IN SUBSECTION (B) OF THIS SECTION, A person shall have a permit issued under this subtitle before the person carries, wears, or transports a handgun.
Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5-303(b)): (1) THIS SUBSECTION APPLIES ONLY IN HARFORD COUNTY. (2) A PERSON WHO HAS THE WRITTEN CONSENT OF THE GOVERNING BOARD OF A BONA FIDE CHURCH TO CARRY A HANDGUN ON THE PROPERTY OF THE CHURCH DURING SERVICES AND GATHERINGS AND HAS THE INTENT TO WEAR, CARRY, OR TRANSPORT A HANDGUN FOR PURPOSES RELATED TO SELF–PROTECTION OR THE PROTECTION OF OTHERS WHILE ON THE PROPERTY OF THE CHURCH MAY, WITHOUT A PERMIT, WITH ADVANCE NOTICE TO THE HARFORD COUNTY SHERIFF: (I) CARRY A HANDGUN ON THE PROPERTY OF THE CHURCH DURING SERVICES AND GATHERINGS; AND (II) TRANSPORT A HANDGUN TO AND FROM SERVICES AND GATHERINGS OF THE CHURCH.
Section 2 (uncodified): on or before December 31, 2021, the Harford County Sheriff shall report to the Governor and, in accordance with § 2–1257 of the State Government Article, the General Assembly on the effect on Harford County of § 5–303(b) of the Public Safety Article, as enacted by Section 1 of this Act,
